description: Read or write one chrome.storage key from the background, over the control channel.

action.description: get reads a key or the whole area; set writes one.

browser.description: Session browser; required when several run.

projectPath.description: Project root of a running session: extension_dev, extension_start, or `npx extension dev|start` by hand

value.description: Value to set; for null or "" use valueJson.

valueJson.description: Value as JSON text; not with value.

name: extension_storage
